notes.title: v1.5 - 'Restored'
notes.content:
This update started with an endless mode in mind but once again I couldn't tackle that without risking to mess with the whole game. If I'm going to try that again I'm pretty sure I'll do it with a spin-off/sequel-lite

So, the next best thing was to optimize the difficulty curve, increase a bit the average run time and... restore the old missiles system. The new system made things extra hard for some players, forcing them to use guns, took me some time off from the game (and a bunch of negative reviews) to realize that mistake

Talking about reviews, if you're enjoying the game and have some time to spare, please consider giving it a review 🙏

That's it, changelog below 🫡

[h3]Restored Missile System[/h3]
[list]
[*]No more need to kill enemies with guns to refill missiles: every 60 seconds you'll get a missile drop, or less, if you have 'Premium' upgrades
[*]Restored the 'Premium+' upgrade so you can go for a missile-ish build
[/list]
[h3]Operations & Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*]'First Strike' and 'Endgame' are now both daily operations (with daily seed): for easy and hard difficulty
[*]'Hostile Territory' is dedicated to random runs and now has a permanent board: difficulty sits in the middle with a new 'adaptive' difficulty
[*]Sky Towers and Heavy Turrets will shoot only when you are facing them
[*]Elites turn rate decreased a bit
[/list]
[h3]Others[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated engine to Unity 6
[*]Fixed thrust vectoring animation for 'Vector' and 'Valkyrie' variants
[*]Fixed some (rare) bugs related to bullets
[/list]

notes.title: v1.5 Preview
notes.content:
Super quick update regarding the upcoming update. You can find it under the BETA branch (look for 'preview' and/or use access code 'topdogtopdog'), I'll write a proper changelog in the official update, here's the TL;DR:
[list]
[*]Old missile system is back
[*]Simplified operation system to 2 game modes
[*]Added a permanent leaderboard for random runs with adaptive wave size
[*]Daily runs are a bit longer
[*]Updated engine + some bugfixing
[/list]
If you're interested, please give it a go and let me know your thoughts! 🫡

notes.title: v1.0 - Release
notes.content:
That's it, [b]TOP DOG[/b] is officially out of Early Access!

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]New main menu + improved settings/input menus
[*]Finished a bunch of 3d models
[*]Added sound feedback for picking up scraps
[*]Added 'operation time' to victory screen and leaderboards
[/list]

[h3] See you on the leaderboards! 🫡[/h3]

notes.title: v0.99D - 'Done'
notes.content:
[u]This is most likely the final update before the imminent release out of Early Access[/u]

[i]Thank you for sticking by all these months[/i] 🙏 I wish I could have handled better the development between version 0.97 and 0.98 (almost a year gap): at that time I had a bit of a middle-age crisis regarding the game and spent a lot of time changing and trying new things that were taking the game too far from its core. Hopefully I learned my lesson for future projects

Changelog below 👇

[h3]Operations[/h3]
[list]
[*]'First Strike' turned into a proper operation: [i]5 stages long and with the smoothest difficulty curve of all ops[/i]
[*]Increased a bit 'Hostile Territory' score/intensity: which now sits between the new 'First Strike' and 'Endgame'
[*]Removed any daily gating to operations: [i]you'll need unlock them only once (as before)[/i]
[*]Space Elevator stage difficulty tweaked to be on par with Space Station stage
[/list]
[h3]Missile System[/h3]
[list]
[*]'Premium' upgrade will now add a baseline missile refill: [i]similar to how it was before the 'FAFO' update[/i]
[*]Tweaked some missile refill stats
[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added 3 simple tutorial screens to teach game's basic mechanics
[*]Defeat/Victory screen updated with some daily stats: total time + sessions
[*]Fixed a bug with the "Space Dog" achievement stats (Menu > Achievement screen): [i]progress was not properly saved[/i]
[/list]

[h3]That's it! 🫡[/h3]

notes.title: v0.99 - 'FAFO'
notes.content:
[i]Title explained: F*** around (change the score system) and Find Out (that missiles are broken)[/i]

This updated started (with v0.98G) as a simple tweaking pass and later become a rework of the missile system and a final pass on the new scoring

[h3]New Missile System[/h3]
[list]
[*]Missiles are now refilled by gun kills: [i]adds a new tactical layer to the gameplay[/i]
[*]Missile count is now carried over stages: no more free-lunches
[*]Premium upgrades have been adjusted accordingly
[*]Tweaked capacity of all missile types: 12 for Base and PRDTR-4, 24 for SWRM-6
[*]Known issue: SWRM-6 should be refilled at twice the rate of PRDTR-4
[/list]

[h3]Final Scoring[/h3]
[list]
[*]Nuked the accuracy bonus: [i]it's an all you can shoot buffet now[/i]
[*]Added back a time-based bonus ('Stage Bonus') but much more contained than the old combo system: it is given at the end of each stage and [i]you'll briefly see it under the score before the stage ends[/i]
[*]Stage bonus is scaled with stage total wave(s) size
[/list]

[h3]Structures & Pickups[/h3]
[list]
[*]Pickups from Ground Outpost, Space Station and Space Elevator [i]will spawn before complete destruction[/i]
[*]All structures will now [i]block the next wave[/i] until their pickup is spawned
[*]Removed 'Repair & Reload' from the pickup random pool: [i]it is now a simple coin-toss between 'Extra Life' and 'Extra Upgrade'[/i]
[/list]

[h3]General Tweaking & Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*]Elites [i]damage reduced by 16%[/i]
[*]Frigate (engines), Sky Tower and Heavy Turrets health reduced by 33%: [i]made consistent with the other capital ship weakpoints[/i]
[*]Base regen bumped from 4% to 5% per scrap
[*]'Mechanic' regen bumped from 8% to 10% per scrap
[*]'Mechanic+' regen bumped from 12% to 15% per scrap
[*]Added 'Stick Strafe Assist' option (Menu > Controls): on by default (current behaviour)
[/list]

[h3]That's it! 🫡[/h3]

notes.title: v0.98g

notes.title: v0.98 - 'Line Up and Wait'
notes.content:
This is the [i]last major update[/i], lots has changed on the wave/enemy balancing so bear with me a little: v0.99/1.0 will be for the last balancing/polishing touches

A lot of effort has been spent on making each run as unique as possible with varied and interesting waves and no biome repetitions. Also the duration of the average run have been shortened: v0.97 runs were becoming a bit of a chore towards the final waves

There is some new content in this update but it is probably less than what you were looking for and I apologize if I gave wrong expectations: I thought I could do more with it but TD's dev cycle have been quite long and I felt it [i]was more important to improve on the game strengths[/i] instead of adding things just for the sake of it and risk to ruin the game

Enough talking, changelog follows 👇


[h3]New Structures & Pickups[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added Space Elevator
[*]Added Ground Outpost (WIP)
[*]Updated Space Station with the new heavy turrets
[*]When a structure is fully destroyed a [i]random pickup will spawn[/i]: Extra Life, Extra Upgrade or Repair & Reload
[/list]

[h3]New Scoring[/h3]
[list]
[*]Combo system removed and replaced with an accuracy bonus for each enemy damaged/killed event: [i]reason for this change is to give more freedom of action, reward all play styles (not only aggressive) and have a tighter, more competitive leaderboard[/i]
[*]HUD updated accordingly
[/list]

[h3]Upgrades[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can now call for an [i]upgrade as soon as the tech level increases[/i]: added new input mapping for it
[*]Reroll system replaced by a single reroll option that will work like any other upgrade:[i] reason for this change is to make each run more unique and encourage different approaches[/i]
[*]'Armored': [i]back to max hull increase only[/i] (extra life is part of the pickups)
[*]'Scavenger': [i]bumped scraps tech increase from 33% to 50%[/i]
[*]'Adrenaline' changed: [i]time-dilation when locked by enemy missiles[/i]
[/list]

[h3]Enemy Tweaking & Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*]Rogues [i]are now aces[/i] (hexagon on the HUD)
[*][i]No more invulnerability window[/i] for Rogues and Wing Leaders
[*]Enemies are [i]a bit more aggressive[/i] in general
[*]'Viper Elite' renamed to 'Elite' and [i]will appear in more biomes (not only space)[/i]
[/list]

[h3]Operations & Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*]Back to [i]3 lives from start[/i] and changed the HUD representation: 1 triangle = 1 extra life
[*]'Endurance' renamed to 'Endgame': made it shorter (3 stages) but [i]more intense and with an extra upgrade at start[/i]
[*]'Hostile Territory' is now a [i]daily gateway[/i] to 'Endgame'
[*][i]Retry/New buttons[/i] on defeat screen: except for 'Endgame' which uses a daily seed and will show only the retry button
[*]⚠️'First Strike' progress will be reset and everyone will have to replay it: [i]needed to gauge how difficult it has become[/i]
[*]Visual improvements and tweaking for all biomes
[/list]

[h3]That's it! 🫡[/h3]

notes.title: v0.97 - 'Streamlined'
notes.content:
⚠️ [i]Last time that some achievements will be reset, I promise[/i]

[h3]What changed[/h3]
[list]
[*]'First Strike' simplified and locked once completed: will be further tweaked to become the tutorial operation
[*]'Hostile Territory' is the new 'random' operation which gets unlocked by completing 'First Strike'
[*]'Endurance' got longer (12 waves) and more difficult in the end: [i]it gets unlocked permanently when 'Hostile Territory' is completed for the first time[/i]
[*][b]Removed 'Blitz':[/b] [i]game works better when you build your aircraft from the ground up[/i]. Also it was an annoying (daily) gate to 'Endurance'
[/list]

[h3]Tweakings[/h3]
[list]
[*]'Iceman' renamed to 'Adrenaline': slow-motion (less than before) + [i]mobility boost during target locking (when the view is zoomed-in)[/i]
[*]'Scavenger': in addition to better scraps attraction there is also an [i]increase in the "scraps to tech" conversion rate[/i]
[*]Some waves will now have a specific name to better identify (at a glance) their composition
[*]Some tweaking to biomes
[/list]

[h3]That's it! 🫡[/h3]

notes.title: v0.96 - 'Reroll'
notes.content:
⚠️ [i]Some stats and achievements will be reset[/i]

Apologies for the long update: once again things got flipped around but [i]I'm pretty sure this is the last major change to the game structure.[/i]

With this one the game rolls back a little to how it used to be before the endless/operations updates: with more randomization and a simpler progression. [i]Let me know what you think![/i]

[h3]New Campaign Structure[/h3]
[list]
[*]3 operations: more might be added later depending on feedback
[*]'First Strike' is randomized [i]per run[/i]: stage/wave composition and upgrade choice [i]will be different for each new run[/i]
[*]The others are randomized [i]per [b]day[/b][/i]: stage/wave composition and upgrade choice [i]will stay the same throughout the day and [b]reset[/b] the next day[/i]
[*]'Blitz' operations are short, intense and start with pre-installed upgrades: currently there's only 'Valkyrie' (which is not very different from v0.95's) but more will be added later to the random pool
[*]You now start with 2 lives instead of 3
[/list]

[h3]Rerolls & Upgrades Tweaking[/h3]
[list]
[*]You now get 3 (upgrade choice) rerolls per operation
[*]Tech leveling has been tweaked to allow quicker upgrading: runs will usually end at tech 6-8
[*]Buffed 'GAU-30'
[*]Added 'Premium+': unlocked with achievement 'Fox Two'
[*]Changed 'Armored': max hull increase [i]+ extra life[/i]
[/list]

[h3]Other Changes & General Tweaking[/h3]
[list]
[*]Increased Frigate jump time
[*]Reduced invulnerability windows for Rogues and Wing Leaders
[*]Removed Valkyrie sliding on surfaces
[*]Restored triangle icon for Elite Vipers
[*]Changed missile/drone icons to diamond shape
[/list]

[h3]That's it! 🫡[/h3]

notes.title: v0.95 - 'Operations'
notes.content:
⚠️ [i]Some stats and achievements will be reset[/i]

Sorry about the stats reset! Was not an easy decision but I managed to limit it to stats related to the new operations system, all the upgrade unlocks and kill stats are intact.

[h3]Operations[/h3]
[list]
[*]There are currently 4 operations: some of which are unlocked at start and each with something special. [i]I'm eager to hear your thoughts for making making new operations and/or tweak the current ones[/i]
[*]Completing an operation will make it go up one tier (currently up to max 3): the idea is to increase the difficulty each tier and [i]make all operations a viable choice regarding the score/challenge you can get from them[/i]
[*]Leaderboard entries will show which operation was run and if completed (otherwise last wave number is displayed)
[/list]

[h3]Main Changes & Tweaking[/h3]
[list]
[*]Replaced endless looping with operations system
[*]Added Space Station enemy, first pass: destruction effects are not finished and its fight mechanics might be changed later
[*]Frigates cannot jump if you destroy their engine
[*]Wing Leaders got a bit more aggressive
[*]Rogues can be killed with 1 normal/swarm missile: makes fighter class (triangle icon) more consistent
[*]Bumped a little base scraps attraction force
[*]GAU-30 damage tweaked
[*]Armor cap restored at 250% (was 200%)
[*]Fixed some inconsistencies with bullets raycasting
[*]Vector: restored normal paint
[*]Valkyrie: comes in black and can now "slide" on surfaces 👀
[/list]

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Achievements page: merged stats into achievements
[*]Added ‘Stronger Dog’ achievement
[*]Added ‘Rabid Dog’ achievement
[*]Added ‘Daily Dog’ achievement
[*]Changed ‘Sky Dog’ achievement: now you have to successfully take an extra life from the Sky Tower
[*]Changed ‘Elite Dog’ achievement: reach 1,000 total kills
[/list]

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
[list]
[*]Tweaking & balancing for the new operations system
[*]Input system refactoring to support multiple devices and possibily a better input binding menu
[*]First player experience: some kind of quick tutorial in the first operation
[/list]

[h3]That's it! 🫡[/h3]

notes.title: SITREP #6 - Update & 'Operations' Preview
notes.content:
⚠️ [i]v0.92 ETA: Saturday 11th (18th at the latest)[/i]

[h3]What's happening[/h3]
As you can see from the thumbnail, a new enemy is getting ready and as you probably gathered from last update we are going back to a finite number of waves and shorter runs. Your response on last update was very useful and made the decision to switch much easier, [b]Thanks![/b]

[h3]Operations[/h3]
We are going back to short and challenging runs, where TD really shine but this time you will be able to run different 'Operations': each with a different distribution of enemies, difficulty and some special features (such as bonus upgrade at start, more upgrade choices, etc.).

There will be no changes to the daily leaderboard, except for showing on which operation the score was obtained.

notes.title: v0.91d
notes.content:
[list]
[*]No more tech limits for upgrades: not fun and uncessary nerfing
[*]Mechanic+ upgrade is back: same as above
[*]Getting Premium upgrade in the middile of a stage will sped up the current reload (if in progress) or do an insta-refill
[*]For new players: all upgrades are unlocked during the very first operation
[/list]

notes.title: v0.91 - 'Elites & Tweaks'
notes.content:
Focus of this update has been on tweaking the enemies/difficulty for later waves to avoid the session going on forever.

Which brings us to a very important first poll I'd like to make about endless: [i]what do you like about endless?[/i]

The previous version with 10 waves was definitely too short and difficulty was not ramping up enough towards the final waves, current version does a better job up to the 20th wave, for those of you that go beyond that: at which point do you think the game gets hard enough to be satisfied with the run? [i](better to check out v0.91 first to answer this)[/i]

[i]The reason I'm asking is because I'm thinking of going back to a finite amount of waves/stages, the more answers I get the more informed the final decision will be[/i] 🙏

[h3]All The Things[/h3]
[list]
[*]Viper Elites got their own icon and special (pew pew) gun
[*]Frigates: main gun tweaking + new mini-jump behaviour
[*]Wing Leaders: gun/damage tweaking
[*]Adjusted tech progression [strike]and introduced tech limits for some upgrades, example: Valkyrie appears only from level 6 onwards[/strike]
[*]Missiles tweaking: more damage for Standard and Swarm (2 hits for aces and elites, 1 hit for Vipers and Rogues) + tweaking clip size
[*]Combo system reworked to better account for missiles usage
[*]Armor capped at max 200% (was 250%)
[*][strike]Removed Mechanic+[/strike]
[*]Finished Valkyrie model
[*]Some new stats added to the Achievements page
[/list]

[h3]That's it! 🫡[/h3]

notes.title: v0.90 - 'Endless'
notes.content:
Here it is: [i]the endless mechanic is finally in[/i] with a bunch of new stuff and lots of tweaking all around.

I've tried a lot of different things for this one, major one was to have a random selection of stages (even from the start) but it didn't feel quite right. The current implementation has mostly fixed stages but wave composition and upgrade choices is always randomized.

Balancing probably got broken here and there, so bear with me until we do some more testing and I hope you will enjoy the new stuff! 👇

[h3]Major Stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*][i]Added endless mechanic[/i] and reworked stage/wave progression
[*]Upgrade system: now showing [i]only unlocked upgrades + all choices (in case of branching)[/i]
[*][i]Added 'Valkyrie' plane upgrade:[/i] Vector + Supersonic + Mecha legs
[*]Added 'PRTDR-4' upgrade (missiles)
[*]'IR-4' replaced by 'SWRM-6' (missiles)
[*]Added 'AC-30': unlocked from the start and now necessary to obtain 'GAU-30' or 'AC-60'
[*]Added 'Viper Elite' enemy: stage 'Zero-G' and 'Rabid Dogs 2' onwards
[*]Added 'Elite Dog' achievement
[/list]

[h3]Tweaking, Polishing & Bugfixing[/h3]
[list]
[*]Rogues are now giving 4 scraps total (was 2)
[*]Frigates no longer give free scraps: you get only what you kill
[*]No more collisions with Frigates and Towers small wreckage
[*]Default missiles: better target tracking
[*]AC-60: damage increase + worse accuracy when overheating
[*]GAU-20: renamed 'GAU-30' + damage increase
[*]Added 'Show Less Players' button to Leaderboards
[*]Showing some stats in the achievements page
[*]Fixed stage freezing when enemies get in the ground (rareish)
[/list]

[h3]That's it! 🫡[/h3]

notes.title: SITREP #5 - 'Going Endless'
notes.content:
[h3]What's happening[/h3]
Plans changed a bit from the last update, many of you have called for an endless mode and so I've been working on that: it wont be a separate mode but part of the main mode. If you are familiar with [i]Nuclear Throne[/i] looping you get the idea.

I think I need [i]one or two more weeks[/i] to make it good enough for a [i]first pass in v0.86[/i]: it will provide more fun daily runs while I finally work on new content.

Speaking of which, some sketching for new capital ships 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783902/05d17da6e9adb182cd9c3b64b5ad760fc60ff7cd.png[/img]

And some progress on the 'Ultimate' plane upgrade (= Vector + Supersonic) 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783902/6e3cfc5d273bb6346ef6745ed1a00add64dc0e2e.png[/img]

[h3]That's it! 🫡[/h3]

notes.title: v0.85 - 'Lean & Mean'
notes.content:
With this update [i]all mechanics are more or less final[/i]: it took a while because I've spent some time testing a few solutions (of varying complexity) for target locking and upgrade selection but ended up streamlining those and not making major changes.

Focus will now switch to [i]content creation[/i]: enemy types (3-6 more), waves variation, player upgrades (at least 4 more) and polishing.

Game progression/session length is also quite final: 10 waves seem to be the right number but I'm considering [i]adding a difficulty selection[/i] at the start of the run that will make the game more challenging for veteran players. What do you think?

[h3]All the things[/h3]
[list]
[*]Target Lock (B button/LMB) improved: aim assist + strafe-assist for stick controls
[*]Score combo tweaking: less emphasis on aggressive play, combo decay is now affected by time and gun use
[*]Disabled collisions with enemy fighters and aces
[*]Upgrade selection streamlined: less waiting after a wave clear and bonus upgrade on last wave
[*]IR-4 upgrade improved: ammo + maneuverability increase
[*]Wing Leaders and Rogues invulnerability time tweaking: 30% decrease
[*]AI sticks more to map center: this will lessen the problem of reaching map limits. I consider this one pretty much resolved except for maybe some HUD warnings approaching the limits at a later date
[*]HUD flashing on hits: target icons and menus are no more affected by it
[*]Intro music completed: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PC6rwBrSenQ]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PC6rwBrSenQ[/url]
[*]Mouse input takes priority over other devices: should help solve input issues some of you are having
[/list]

Shoutout to [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1V4soer96P8]Splattercatgaming for covering TD[/url] 🙏


[h3]That's it! 🫡[/h3]

notes.title: v0.84 - 'Rogues'
notes.content:
[h3]Reworked progression[/h3]
First of all, there are [i]10 waves in total now[/i] (instead of the 12-13 we had). Focus has shifted from the stage (desert, clouds, space) to the single wave: each has it's own name (and a bit of character, if you will) and can escalate, for example: 'Furball' > 'Furball II'.

Current progression is split in 3 sections: the middile will feature the new 'Rogue' enemy and each section will shuffle the order and selection of waves to offer a more varied run each time.

Current balancing is not final and probably the game is a bit more difficult now [i]so please bear with me while we tweak it out together with the upcoming updates.[/i]

[h3]All the things[/h3]
[list]
[*]New progression system
[*]New 'Rogue' enemy: a more aggressive fighter that can strafe and takes 2 hits
[*]New 'Scavenger' Upgrade: for maximum scraps attraction
[*]Better 'Armored' Upgrade: boosts hull to 150% but no more extra life (there are towers for that)
[*]Tweaked 'Wing Leader': still the hardest enemy but now a bit more consistent in it's behaviour + there are less of them (maybe except for the final wave 🙃)
[*]Tweaked 'Sky Tower': takes one less hit + repair pickup gets activated on first hit + proper extra life pickup icon
[*]'Sky Dog' achievement changed: obtained by destroying 5 sky towers
[*]Interceptors are now officially aces: hex icon + ace category
[*]New 'Vector' variant paint job: now comes in sexy black with red lines (rogues are using the same)
[*]No more HUD flashing red during upgrade selection (rare-ish)
[*]Added 'Stick Accel' option (Menu > Controls): setting it to 'exponential' might be useful if you are using a hotas setup
[/list]

[h3]That's it! 🫡[/h3]

notes.title: SITREP #4 - v0.84 Preview
notes.content:
I've been working on a better wave/stage system but it needs some more time for basic tweaking and balancing: [i]by next saturday it should be in a playable state for you to check out.[/i]

[h3]What's happening [i](work in progress, not in the current build)[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*]New progression system based on waves (and not stages): it will allow for more randomness and finer tuning
[*]New 'Traitor/Defector' enemy (let me know which name you like better): a more aggressive viper that can strafe
[*]Tweaked 'Wing Leader' enemy: will be a bit more consistent in it's behaviour and there will be less of them
[*]New 'Scavenger' Upgrade: for maximum scraps attraction
[*]Better 'Armored' Upgrade: boosts hull to 150% but no more extra life (there are towers for that)
[/list]
[h3]That's it! 🫡[/h3]

notes.title: v0.83 - 'Mechanic++'
notes.content:
[h3]Big Stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*]Baseline 'Mechanic' + tweaking: you now get 'scraps repair' by default (4% per 1 scrap) and the 'Mechanic' and 'Mechanic+' upgrades are boosting that to 8% and 12% (numbers are not final)
[*]Leaderboard overhaul: 'smart view' that prioritizes friends + full view if you scroll down ('Show more players' button) + total (fighter) kills under the name
[*]Last day leaderboard view: you can take a peek once (for now)
[/list]

[h3]Tweaking & Polishing[/h3]
[list]
[*]'Supersonic' boosted: goes to ridiculous speed, outrunning missiles
[*]Enemy Missiles/Drones arrows: they show up only when you are actually pointed at
[*]'Enemy Hit' sound: a bit more hearable
[/list]

I wanted to include more stuff in this update but I think there's enough to go around until the next big one which will include a new player upgrade and probably a new enemy.

Thinking further ahead: I'd like to do some improvements to the 'target lock' and begin to make stages a bit more random.

Let me know what you think, and please don't forget that I'm reading every bit of your feedback even if I don't always reply.

[h3]That's it![/h3]

notes.title: v0.82b

notes.title: v0.82 - 'Guns Guns Guns!'
notes.content:
[h3]The big stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added [i]'Stick Mode'[/i] option (menu > controls): this one is for gamepad/stick players, it will allow to play with the classic flight-sim [i]'roll & pull'[/i] kind of controls, which is now the default setting (if you prefer the simpler scheme, you can set it back to [i]'yaw & roll'[/i]). That is something that was already in the game but I decided to disable for silly reasons
[*]Bumped bullet thickness:  so guns are a bit easier to aim and more fun in general
[*]AI is now limited by ceiling altitude the same as the player
[*]Added overheating mechanic to GAU-20 and AC-60: this is another feature I had dormant in the game
[/list]

[h3]Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*]Plane turning rates got bumped a bit
[*][i]'Supersonic'[/i] variant has better strafing: it's now in the middle between base plane and the [i]'Vector'[/i]
[*]GAU-20 spread decreased a little (but same as before during overheating)
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Some AI navigation bugs
[*]Frigates now attempt some obstacle avoidance
[*]Mouse sensitivity adjusted when zooming
[/list]

[h3]That's it![/h3]

notes.title: SITREP #3 - 'Sky Tower'
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783902/494c62b13a21001f11d29155ce5a50d8d7d6651c.gif[/img]

This is the first static type of enemy you'll encounter in the game, it will appear in the second stage of the game: [i]the Clouds[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783902/a4d38727fb98c64755e3d337554db7d7557ef632.gif[/img]

When you get close enough, it will launch drones from the hangar, [i]which can be damaged only for a few seconds while the doors are open[/i]. And each time you damage it, a repair pick-up will immediately replenish on top (which currently has a cycle of 30 sec).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783902/b2aa9d1bce6354e770eebdd1af5ec35e22b9475d.png[/img]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
I'm planning to have at least 3 stages for the (Early Access) release: [i]each introducing something new[/i]. First two stages (Desert and Clouds) are pretty much complete and so I'll be working on the third stage.

[h3]That's it![/h3]

notes.title: SITREP #2 - 'Frigate'
notes.content:
Apologies for the late SITREP, I wanted to finish the Frigate before making an update but there's so much work to do.

Here we go with an "almost finished" version:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783902/1e36d8365de7c6fbac2fbcacc63b699b463c554e.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Enemy 'Warship' type: basically a boss
[*]Single 360° heavy turret on top
[*]Fire missiles from the sides
[*]Drop mines when you get close enough
[*]A bunch of critical points to destroy before killing it
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783902/eed9180808fa68803a03e53538fc9dc18f928963.gif[/img]

What's left to do is to remodel the sides (at first I redesigned them with vertical mounted turrets but they got scrapped in favor of the missiles) and tweak some more the behaviour: like activating the missiles only after getting damaged.

[h2]Release Date Shift[/h2]
As you might have noticed the release date got postponed to early 2023. I underestimated the amount of work needed for the boss-like enemies and these few extra months ahead will hopefully be enough to get a solid Early Access release.

[h3]That's it![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783902/21871b191d28f8edf9b9d41acb114f9779baaa85.gif[/img]
